pos.personaBrief: France had 48-49% possession (20th), 34% in the final, and Deschamps said possession-heavy teams were punished by fast forwards; they ceded the ball to Belgium and countered with Mbappe.

pro.personaBrief: theScore: Deschamps prioritised fundamental football, clearing the lines and moving the ball forward; Pogba's long ball to Mbappe, getting the ball into the opponent's half fast, counters.

est.personaBrief: A disciplined 4-2-3-1 / 4-4-1-1 with defined roles; Giroud held up play and acted as decoy, Griezmann dropped deep, wide players tucked in; little rondo-style combination.

lar.personaBrief: France built a central screen (Kante, Pogba, Matuidi on the left in place of a winger) and ceded wide space; attack was direct counters, not winger crossing.

blo.personaBrief: Sat deep and narrow, 24m between lines, Deschamps said they defended very deep against Belgium; forwards did press the centre-backs and midfielders, but not a high-press team.

mar.personaBrief: No source states the marking scheme; compact spatial defending and a block that protects zones suggest zonal, with pragmatic reading and no evidence of dedicated man-marking.

pla.personaBrief: Deschamps adapted style to each opponent (most appropriate style per occasion, reshaped v Uruguay set pieces, Giroud back after Australia, deep v Belgium).

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic result-first: counters and set pieces, 'anti-football' accusation, first substitution a defensive midfielder in the final; Deschamps cares about winning, not beauty.

sis.personaBrief: Collective organisation first: Griezmann and Giroud worked defensively, stars given roles; the group and system over individual freedom, though talent (Mbappe) was used on counters.

jog.personaBrief: Physically imposing centre-backs, Kante/Pogba/Matuidi engine, pace of Mbappe; set-piece headers decided games; no classic number 10, ex-defensive midfielder manager.

bas.personaBrief: Young squad (many World Cup debutants, 22-year-old full-backs, 19-year-old Mbappe) picked on merit and defensive quality; no club academy dimension; youth were key figures in the title.

lid.personaBrief: Deschamps excluded Benzema and Rabiot to protect group cohesion, no star exceptions, he is the boss; decisions his own, though keeping dialogue and harmony was a stated concern.
